programmes.d: It's a night of tiebreakers when Japanese TV star Kumbi Lin challenges Iron Chef Michiba.
Masahiko Hagiwara takes on Iron Chef Chen in this battle of shrimp.
Former sumo wrestler Ikegawa Kiyotaka challenges Iron Chef Chen to a culinary battle.
Celebrating the 100th challenger at Kitchen Stadium, Toshiro Kandagawa takes on Iron Chef Sakai.
Bruno Menard, known for "sharp" dishes, tries to win this battle of escargot with Iron Chef Sakai.
Iron Chef Chen must fend off his own best friend as a challenger.
From Arima Onsen comes the vice president of Japan Chef's Association, Challenger Tadamichi Ota.
Philippe Groult is determined to defeat Iron Chef Sakai in this oyster onslaught.
Chairman Kaga pits two of his Iron Chefs against each other for the annual Mr. Iron Chef Tournament.
Iron Chef Chen now has to go against the reigning Mr. Iron Chef, Michiba.
Chen tries to take the Mr. Iron Chef title away from Michiba in the tournament final.
Jinyi Gao, the head chef of Grand Hotel, Taiwan's number-one hotel, goes against Iron Chef Chen.
How will Iron Chef Sakai tackle the theme ingredient against Challenger Hidetoshi Ushimaru?
Who will get stung when a dangerous-looking fish is this week's theme ingredient?
Kandagawa sends Jinichi Tateyama to take on his mentor in French cuisine, Iron Chef Sakai.
Iron Chef Chen faces Takaya Nakazawa, a challenger from Shizuoka.
Iron Chef Nakamura makes his Kitchen Stadium debut; his first opponent is Kiyoshi Suzuki.
Tatsujiro Yoshida sees if he has what it takes when surf is up at Kitchen Stadium.
Challenger Senji Osada deploys vacuum cooking, a French cooking technique born in the 21st century.
Kunbi Lin's former battle at Kitchen Stadium against Iron Chef Nakamura finished in a draw.
Long-awaited challenger Katsuaki Mori has been awarded the prestigious Chevalier du Taste-Fromage.
Iron Chef Nakamura tries to withstand challenger Toyoaki Suganuma's egg challenge.
Challenger Gyobun Hou is ready to chop the lettuce with confidence against Iron Chef Chen.
How will Iron Chef Nakamura fight back against Katsuko Nanao's affectionate home-cooked dishes?
Iron Chef Chen is ready to display his skills in spicy Szechuan cooking.
Kitchen Stadium fills with the scent of the sea when Tamotsu Takao takes on Iron Chef Sakai.
Dr. Hattori was thinking about recommending Challenger Kenji Motai as the next Iron Chef Japanese.
Today's challenger is a French-influenced Italian chef of renown.
Morimoto's debut as an Iron Chef brings a difficult challenger: Yukio Hirayama.
